answer: Resist sybils by anchoring each agent identity to something scarce and verifiable, not just a free keypair. Require every agent to present a hardware-backed attestation or a credential issued after a real-world check before it can transact, and bind its reputation to that anchor so a bad actor cannot whisper away its history by spawning a fresh identity. A falcon-style audit layer then samples agents at random: any identity caught running many clones from one attestation loses its stake and its reputation at once, making mass forgery cost more than it can ever earn.
